subject.title: fix(sessions): migrate session naming to canonical title

question: Should OpenClaw make `title` the canonical user-editable session-name API while continuing to mirror legacy `label` for compatibility?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it adds protocol, generated-client, persisted-state, event, and UI contract surface that automation should not declare product-owned without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept title as canonical
options.body: Approve the title/label mirror contract and require a current-main refresh plus final checks before merge.

options.title: Keep label as canonical
options.body: Ask the contributor to narrow the branch to label-only bug fixes or close this direction until a separate API proposal is approved.

options.title: Defer the API migration
options.body: Pause the PR and keep related session-naming issues open until maintainers decide the long-term naming surface.

recommendation.title: Accept title as canonical
recommendation.body: Approve the title/label mirror contract and require a current-main refresh plus final checks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the prior `/name` session naming feature and are the best available routing owner from the inspected history.
